title: Fastino GLiDE v1.2 Tops Hugging Face Decision Index With 71.5 Score
summary:
Fastino AI has added support for multimodal inputs including text, JSON, and images to its latest suite of decision tools. The company launched the corresponding model weights on the Hugging Face platform to allow developers to integrate the system into their own applications.

The new model, GLiDE v1.2, currently holds the first position on the Hugging Face Decision Index with an overall score of 71.5. It has one of the lowest calibration errors on the index, meaning its reported confidence closely aligns with its accuracy. Fastino also provides hosted inference via its API for $0.04 per million input tokens.

Our newest decision model is the world's best decision model.

Introducing GLiDE v1.2, the #1 model on the @huggingface Decision Index.

With an overall score of 71.5, GLiDE v1.2 also has one of the lowest calibration errors on the entire Decision Index, meaning its confidence more closely reflects how often its answers are correct.

Beyond improved benchmark performance, it also adds support for multimodal inputs, enabling decision-making using text, JSON, and images.

We are excited to release the model weights on Hugging Face. For hosted inference, you can also run GLiDE v1.2 through the Fastino API at $0.04 / million input tokens.
